Identity takes priority. Body center x=512, ground contact y=942 on a 1024 canvas; standing body about 700 pixels from head/buns to foot, max full equipment extent inside x=65..960 and y=45..952. Neither a leap, run, kick, attack, crossed legs nor standing. Make clean leg articulation and genuine weight-bearing contact with a small natural counter-swing of hair and sleeves. Do not reproduce the lifted-knee airborne portrait pose. Highest available visual finish. No purple/magenta rim, no colored matte. Image 3 is the current front walking reference: preserve precisely this rendering, character dimensions, outfit and spear grip while drawing the specified DIFFERENT leg pose from scratch.
